dhl.title: Track parcel numbers (DHL, DPD & Hermes)
dhl.description: Add one or more tracking numbers (press Enter after each). Whether a number belongs to DHL, DPD or Hermes is detected automatically - this entry covers all three carriers. You can also start empty and add numbers later via the options.

data.default_postcode: Your postcode (only needed if a DPD number is protected)

dpd.title: Log in with your DPD account
dpd.description: Log in with your myDPD account. All parcels (sent, received, returns) will then be detected automatically.

amazon.title: Log in with your Amazon.de account
amazon.description:
⚠️ Security note: after login the Amazon session (cookies) is stored locally in Home Assistant in plain text, including in backups. That session grants full access to your Amazon account (orders, addresses, payment methods). Only use this if you're comfortable with that. The password itself is used only for the login and is not stored.

Note: Amazon often blocks logins from datacenter/VPS networks with a CAPTCHA - the automatic login then cannot complete.

amazon_otp.title: Amazon verification code
amazon_otp.description: Amazon requires an additional verification step. Enter the one-time code from your authenticator app, SMS or email.

add_tracking_number.name: Add tracking number
add_tracking_number.description: Adds a tracking number to Paketverfolgung, unless it's already tracked. The carrier (DHL, DPD or Hermes) is detected automatically.

tracking_number.name: Tracking number
tracking_number.description: The tracking number (DHL, DPD or Hermes).

remove_tracking_number.name: Remove tracking number
remove_tracking_number.description: Removes a tracking number from Paketverfolgung.

set_tracking_carrier.name: Set carrier
set_tracking_carrier.description: Pins a tracking number to a carrier when auto-detection gets it wrong. "auto" clears the override.

set_tracking_name.name: Set name
set_tracking_name.description: Gives a shipment a custom label. Leave empty to clear it.
